description: Make a straw poll (a question and 2-20 choices) and get a share link people vote on with no account, with live results; read the results or close it. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

examples.question: Where shall we have lunch on Friday?

action.description: create (default) makes a poll and returns its share link and owner link. results returns the current counts. close stops voting now, reopen starts it again, delete takes the poll down for good: those three need the ownerKey from create, or the signed-in account that made it. list returns the signed-in caller's polls.

allowVoterChoices.description: create: true lets voters add a choice of their own while the poll is open. Default false.

askNames.description: create: true shows an optional name field to voters; the organiser can then see who picked what. Default false: anonymous.

choices.description: create: the choices, 2 to 20, as plain strings in the order they should appear. Blank ones and duplicates are dropped.

items.description: One choice people can vote for, e.g. 'Pizza'.

closeAfterMinutes.description: create: stop voting this many minutes from now, e.g. 60 or 1440 for a day. Leave out to close by hand (action: close).

closesAt.description: create: stop voting at this moment instead, as ISO 8601 with a UTC offset, e.g. '2026-12-04T11:30:00+01:00'. Ignored when closeAfterMinutes is given.

days.description: create: how many days the link (and the results) stay up before the poll is deleted. Default 30, capped at the caller's plan (7 days signed out); a longer ask is shortened and the reply says so.

hideResults.description: create: when voters see the counts. 'never' hides nothing (default), 'until_vote' shows them after the voter has voted, 'until_closed' only once voting has stopped. The organiser always sees them.

locale.description: create: the language of the poll page: en, de, es, fi, fr, it, nl, pl or pt. Default en.

multipleChoice.description: create: true lets each voter pick more than one choice. Default false: one choice each.

ownerKey.description: close, reopen, delete, and results while they are hidden: the owner key from create (the part after #owner= in ownerUrl). Not needed when signed in as the account that made the poll.

question.description: create: the question, shown as the page heading, e.g. 'Where shall we have lunch on Friday?'. Up to 200 characters.

token.description: results, close, reopen, delete: the poll's token, from create or list, or the last part of its link /poll/<token>/.

name: straw_poll
title: Straw Poll
